seed_conversion: int(seed_hex, 16); pass the full integer to tools/pick.py and tools/contribute.py
scope_change: Take the matching open handoff's fixed-cap repair of the highest-gap existing maze case, rather than repeat the predecessor's completed 20-case ranking audit.
question: Can one predeclared random4 repair improve SOL below 7815 on maze-32-32-4-n128 without increasing SOC above 8225 or makespan above 125?
method: Existing prioritized random-four-agent neighborhood repair, unchanged; tools/contribute.py -> repair_round2.run -> repair.improve.
development_inputs: The already published maze case and its current Pareto incumbent; exposed calibration material.
evaluation_inputs: Same fixed exposed instance; no unseen transfer or policy-selection claim.
selection_rule: One fixed seed and variant. Keep the final route, including a null result. No parameter search, alternate seeds, or best-of-many selection.
stopping_rule: Stop search at the first of 100000 popped states, 96 attempts, or 600 wall seconds. Retain every attempt and failure. No research pivot is planned.
success_test: Standalone checker accepts the exact bound route; SOL < 7815, SOC <= 8225, makespan <= 125. Otherwise report a null result or obstruction.
falsification_test: Any invalid binding, illegal route, metric mismatch, resource-cap excess, or claimed no-regression violation rejects the result. Audit all accepted intermediate routes and replay deterministic non-timing outputs.
positive_controls: Check the inherited route with tools/verify_candidate.py
Regenerate the 20-case headroom report and confirm the selected case's bound witnesses.
baseline_identity: Current archive random4-seed29 at the pinned base; existing LaCAM3-derived repair witness. No new native solver comparison.
